## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4f6b0f20360c370a065a7ee270a62af185f67ebe`
Local-runs: probe — one detached worktree at the head, removed afterwards, in which `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint` were run once (ceiling 402 with zero headroom is the fact the record stands on), `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27998` was read, and the head's `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` / `stripSignatureLine` were exercised on the dev's actual report comment; nothing built, no gate family beyond these two
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md + scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (header :468-477, `signatureRefusal` :3856-3860), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`SEAT_SIGNATURE_SOURCE` :1305, `readSignatureLine` :1329, `stripSignatureLine` :1343-1350, `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` :12274-12313 and its H52 tests :33190-33203), scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs (`reportedStatus` :223-229), scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs (`classifyRulingComment` :336-337), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (:2163, :2655-2665), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (row :1553), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (`EXTRA_FILES` :89), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md :155 (read only as a sibling sentence)

### ① Derived judgments

Base `origin/main` at review time is `469436572`; the merge base of the head is `6d5c021d9`, the commit the dispatch order and the dev's measurement name. The diff is exactly `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` lines 17-18, +2/−2, one commit, no recogniser touched. Every claim the two new lines make, judged against the tree at the head:

1. 「经 `post-stamped.mjs` 写:首行席位签名」 — TRUE. `post-stamped.mjs:468-473`: the first non-empty line of every body the tool writes, `--comment` and `--body` alike, is `LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION`, and a body whose first line is not one is `EXIT_REFUSED` before any request, a dry run included; `main` judges `signatureRefusal(input)` on both modes (:3856-3860). The shape is `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` (`check-half-states.mjs:1305-1312`), read by `readSignatureLine` (:1329). Naming `post-stamped.mjs` as the writer is what triage 6516073129 and the card's Wanted section ask for.
2. 「次行纯文本 `os-dev-report`」 — TRUE. `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` (`check-half-states.mjs:12310`) is anchored with `^`, then one optional `SEAT_SIGNATURE_SOURCE` line, then optional whitespace or blockquote marks, then the bare or HTML-commented `os-dev-report` ending the line, anchored at the start of the body with ONE optional leading signature line and blank lines tolerated between; a marker on any later line, or below two signature lines, is refused (tests :33196, `record-recognisers.mjs:2665`). `stripSignatureLine` (:1343-1350) removes one signature line and the blank lines around it, so every first-line recogniser reads the signed body as it read the unsigned one (`post-stamped.mjs:476-477`). The unsigned line-1 form still reads too (test :33190), so no legacy comment is orphaned by this wording.
3. Every reader of `os-dev-report` under `scripts/pm` and `.claude` accepts the line-2 form: `check-handover.mjs:229` (`reportedStatus`, the H19/NEEDS_DECISION reader) tests `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` directly and its own fixture :803 builds the signed shape; `check-prior-rulings.mjs:337` (`classifyRulingComment`) reads the first content line after `stripSignatureLine`; H52 (`devReportOpenQuestions`, `latestMarkedComment`) runs on the same marker; `record-recognisers.mjs:2163` keeps a bare report from counting as a record, signed or not (:2664). `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:4909` is a test fixture carrying the unsigned form, which still reads. The dev's `readers_measured` list is the same set; nothing is missed. Probe: the head's `readSignatureLine` parses line 1 of comment 6517040562 as lane `domain:skills`, seat 2, account `os-elon-musk`, session `session_016WV4czpd3gJLpqfxjS3KQc`; `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER.test` is true; `stripSignatureLine` of it starts with `os-dev-report`; `devReportOpenQuestions` parses the fenced JSON with zero questions.
4. 「⛔ 标记不用 HTML 注释」 — kept, true. The marker's banner (:12278-12285) says the HTML-comment form is read-only and must never be written again; `os-dev.md:320` already says 「HTML 注释形不是等价写法,是坏写法」. Nothing contradicts.
5. 「再作终报:PM 机械解析,终报即 JSON 本身」 — a shortening of the old 「再作为终报消息:PM 机械解析它,终报消息就是 JSON 本身」; no fact dropped, the terminal report is still the same JSON.
6. Dropped words: 「单独一行」 (the marker on a line of its own) is carried by the marker regex, which requires the marker line to end in a newline or end of body (`(?:\r?\n|$)`), and by the dev comment's shape; no instruction is lost.
7. Other sentences placing the marker on line 1. In `os-dev.md`: line 60 (the write budget) names the `os-dev-report` comment and places nothing, correctly untouched; line 324 「写完读回那条评论到尾部:只认首行标记保不住正文」 says 「首行标记」 as shorthand for the opening marker inside a sanitizer rule whose point (read the comment back to its tail) is unchanged; it does not instruct a dev where to put the marker, so it does not contradict `post-stamped.mjs`, but the two characters now read as "line-1 marker". Should-fix 1, not owed as a must-fix. Siblings: `execution-duties.md:155` 「标记两种拼写等效(HTML 注释形、首行 `os-dev-report`)」 is the PM-side collection rule, outside the card's named file and a reader-side equivalence that stays true (both spellings still read); the word 首行 is the same positional shorthand. Should-fix 2 for a sibling card; not this PR's debt. The `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` banner's 「the bare first-line text」 lives in a recogniser the ruling forbids touching and its ⭐ line already states the one leading signature; nothing owed.
8. Skill-line ratchet: `os-dev.md` is 402 lines at the head and at the merge base; the row `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:1553` is `['.claude/agents/os-dev.md', 402]` with headroom 0; the diff is line-neutral. Probe: `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` exit 0 and the run exit 0; `check-skill-id-lint.mjs --self-test` exit 0 and the run exit 0 (105 files clean, pattern `#[0-9]{3,}`). The two new lines carry no card number.
9. Line width: the replaced lines are 114 and 116 bytes (were 117 and 108), both at or under 120. The only lines over 120 bytes in the file (369-371, 377) are untouched and pre-date this PR.
10. Register tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27998` (read-only, run in the probe) returns the GOVERNED verdict, exit 3 = `EXIT_TEST_GOVERNED`: Tier S, `.claude/**` ×1 (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`), 4 changed lines under the human-merge threshold. This agrees with the seat's Tier S and corrects triage's Tier H grade, as the dispatch order said the register would.
11. Declarations: PR body carries `Fixes #27962`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, the 维护者速读 block of six lines with the last naming the owed contract review and the register's tier; label `skip-changeset` rode on `pr_create` and `Check Changeset` is green. Commit trailers are `Co-authored-by: Claude` plus `Claude-Session`; no model name, no `Refs #N`.
12. The dev's report comment 6517040562 follows the amended form: line 1 the seat signature, a blank line, line 2 of content `os-dev-report`, then the fenced JSON, which matches `/mnt/project-files/skills-lane-seat2/report-27962.json` field for field (head `4f6b0f20`, `premise_still_valid: true`, `open_questions: []`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`).

### ② Semver level

Nothing publishes: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` belongs to no package and is read by agents, not shipped. `skip-changeset` is correct, `Clause-②: no` is correct, no narrowing is declared or present. No semver level applies.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Seat report `open_questions`: none; `out_of_scope_findings`: none.
- Deviations declared, each read: (a) branch is the platform-assigned `claude/project-thread-3biuja`, the recorded exception; (b) the report comment itself follows the amended form, verified in ① item 12; (c) no PR assignee or reviewer, consistent with the relay-only write posture; (d) `skip-changeset` on the `pr_create` stroke rather than a separate `labels_add`, one write fewer. All accepted.
- Local-runs: the line above names more than one command inside one probe; the read-only shape was broken for the ratchet gate (headroom 0 is the one fact a hand count could not prove) and the same worktree served the id-lint, register and marker reads. Recorded here so the deviation is visible, not hidden under `none`.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (attribution comment names os-elon-musk); no non-bot login to record.
- Contract-review-claim: comment 6517051677 names this session and this head; it is the only comment on the PR; no competing claim, no hold.
- CI at review time on `4f6b0f20` (43 check runs): success — Auto Label, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped (query-options erasure, slot lookup and corpus, tooling self-tests), PR-body guards, Test Core, Test UI, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · workspace, filter; in_progress — Lint · CI/release and engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · source gates; the rest skipped by path filter. No failure. The skill-line ratchet and id-lint run in the Lint family still in progress; the probe in ① item 8 predicts both green, and the landing gate still owes the final all-green read.
- Draft PR, `mergeable_state: blocked`; Tier S, so this PASS record on the current head plus every check green is what lets the owning seat ready and enqueue it. No human approval is owed.

### ④ Design judgment

Rules face, one `hits` file:

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — against the card's acceptance (「`os-dev.md` and `post-stamped.mjs` agree on the first two lines」) and the code on main: the two sentences now say what `post-stamped.mjs` enforces and what every recogniser reads, name the writer so a dev knows the body is refused unsigned rather than discovering it, and keep the HTML-comment prohibition and the JSON-terminal-report rule. A dev following the file literally now produces the comment the fleet writes; the round trip the card was filed over is gone. Line-neutral at a ceiling with zero headroom, inside 120 bytes. Holds.

No schema or ADR in `hits`, so no first-consumer or execution-plan judgment is owed.

1. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:324` 「只认首行标记保不住正文」: 「首行标记」 now reads as a line-1 marker; 「开头标记」 or 「只认标记」 says the same sanitizer rule without the position, at the same byte count or fewer and zero lines. Inside the claimed file; can ride on the next os-dev.md edit.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md:155` 「首行 `os-dev-report`」: the collection rule's positional shorthand predates the signature line; a sibling card for the skills lane can reword it to 「签名后一行」 or drop 首行. Outside this card's named file; not owed by this PR.

- 为什么改：原文让开发者把 `os-dev-report` 写在第 1 行，但唯一允许的写入器 `post-stamped.mjs` 会拒收第 1 行不是签名的正文。每次派发都要为这处矛盾多来回一次，四位开发者都在报告里报过。
- 风险与回滚：只改说明文字，识别器一行没动。所有 `os-dev-report` 读者（`check-half-states`、`check-handover`、`check-prior-rulings`、`record-recognisers`）本来就跳过一行签名，用开发者这次的真实报告 6517040562 实测可读。revert 即回滚。
- 先看：`os-dev.md` 第 17–18 行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 与 `node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` 均 exit 0。
- 需要你做的：无。`.claude/**` 按登记册是 Tier S，契约复核 PASS（记录在本评论之前，`Head-sha: 4f6b0f20360c370a065a7ee270a62af185f67ebe`），由本席转 ready 并开自动合并。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS，没有 must-fix。两条 should-fix 都是同一种位置简写，不阻塞，留到下次改这两个文件时顺手改：`os-dev.md:324` 的「首行标记」，以及 `execution-duties.md:155` 的「首行 `os-dev-report`」。CI 无失败。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #27962`, one file `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (+2/−2, lines 17–18), `skip-changeset`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27998`: Tier S (`.claude/**` ×1).
- **前提实测:** `post-stamped.mjs:468-477` refuses a body whose first non-empty line is not the signature, and `stripSignatureLine` skips one signature line. Every reader of the marker goes through `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` (which allows one optional leading signature line) or `stripSignatureLine`. The dev's own report comment 6517040562 reads in the new form (review ①).
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `4f6b0f20360c370a065a7ee270a62af185f67ebe`: no failures. The line ratchet (402/402) and id-lint were run green locally. The queue's required checks gate the merge.
- **接受的偏差:** none beyond the card. Line 60 (the write budget names the comment only) is correctly left as it is.
- **范围外去向:** should-fixes 1 and 2 (position shorthand at `os-dev.md:324` and `execution-duties.md:155`) ride the next edit of either file.
- **落地条款:** Tier S: the at-tier contract review PASS is on the current head, so the seat flips it ready and arms auto-merge under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
